item: The qualification-assist self-test asks no backend for its window
summary: R319 release note: the qualification-assist self-test (Diagnostics), which runs on a stub and says it uses no model and no network, no longer connects to the local vLLM and Ollama ports to read their context window when that reading has not been made in the last five minutes; the window is held fixed for the self-test's own thread. Found by the GET side-effects walk on a CI shard where the shared cache was cold, measured as two loopback connects (127.0.0.1:8001 and :11434).
